name: Відхід і перекриття
description:
This lesson teaches you another combined form of defending. This time, it is moving away plus blocking. Both in one move.

Take your time to study examples 1 to 3. Watch the moves and read the text. Then you’ll understand how this works and you will be able to do the exercises.


What do you have to do?

Defend against a double attack. Use moving away plus blocking.

examples.text:
White’s king and rook are attacked.
White defends by moving the rook.
Where does it go to?
To the square between king and queen.
Check is blocked and the rook is safe.
Black could still take it, but that would be foolish.
It is defended by the king.

A double attack from Black’s queen on White’s rook and knight.
White moves his rook and places it between the queen and the knight.

Of course, if you use blocking, you have pay to attention.
Your piece must be defended on its new spot, or you will still lose it.

Is it also possible to defend by moving away plus protecting (red arrow)?
No, it is not.
The knight is safe, but White’s rook would be undefended.

Black’s queen threatens mate and attacks the bishop at the same time.
Fortunately, White can move the bishop and place it between the queen and the pawn.
The bishop is safe there and it blocks the mating threat.

texts: Try to save all your pieces.
